description: Praseodymium is a chemical element with symbol Pr and atomic number 59, the third member of the lanthanide series and a rare-earth metal. It is a soft, silvery, malleable and ductile metal that is too reactive to be found in native form, developing a green oxide coating when exposed to air.
uses: Praseodymium is valued for its magnetic, electrical, chemical, and optical properties, with many industrial uses involving its ability to filter yellow light from light sources.
characteristics: It is a ductile metal with hardness comparable to silver, paramagnetic at all temperatures above 1 K, and forms a double hexagonal close-packed crystal structure at room temperature. Praseodymium most readily forms the +3 oxidation state and produces yellowish-green aqueous ions and various shades of yellow-green when incorporated into glasses.
